(pair_kokkos.h:156-181, 326-336, 489-521, ...). PairZBLKokkos::compute_fpair/compute_evdwl (lines 214/234) contain no compensating division. The CPU style deliberately does not scale: PairZBL::compute (src/pair_zbl.cpp:104-145) is 'j = jlist[jj]; j &= NEIGHMASK;' with no sbmask and no factor anywhere in the file ('grep special_lj src/pair_zbl.cpp' is empty). Reachability check: with the common 'special_bonds lj/coul 0 0 0' the excluded pairs are dropped from the neighbour list entirely (Neighbor::init, src/neighbor.cpp:534-550 sets special_flag=0), so both agree; the divergence is real whenever the pairs stay in the list -- fractional factors (e.g. amber's 0.0 0.0 0.5) or a kspace/coul style that forces special_flag=2 with a 0.0 lj factor, where /kk then zeroes a ZBL interaction the CPU applies in full.
fix: Make the /kk style ignore the special factors like its base class: after the force->special_lj copy in PairZBLKokkos::compute(), set 'special_lj[0] = special_lj[1] = special_lj[2] = special_lj[3] = 1.0;' with a comment noting that PairZBL applies the ZBL repulsion to all neighbours regardless of special_bonds (matching pair_zbl.cpp and pair_zbl_omp.cpp).
